identity.mission: Create a top 1% industrial design that breaks B2B conventions. Fusion of 'Industrial Precision' and 'Raw Material Aesthetics'.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix industrial rawness with Swiss precision.
Content is King: Technical specs must be legible but beautiful.
Zoom In: Use macro textures of firebricks and steel.
Negative Space: Don't clutter; let the products breathe.

theme_strategy.logic: Light mode for catalog/readability (trust). Dark mode for Hero/Footer (impact/heat).
theme_strategy.textures: Use subtle grain/noise on dark backgrounds to simulate 'soot' or 'industrial dust' texture.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text. Uppercase for top-level headers.

grid_system.marketing: Bento Grid (Asymmetrical). Use col-span-2 for major items, col-span-1 for minor.
grid_system.catalog: Dense Data Grid. Compact rows, clear borders.

shadcn_overrides.button: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Hover: Lift + Shadow. Primary: Orange bg, White text.
shadcn_overrides.card: Flat, 1px border (slate-200). No shadow by default. Hover: shadow-lg + border-orange-500.
shadcn_overrides.table: Compact. Header: uppercase, tracking-wide, slate-100 bg. Rows: hover:bg-slate-50.

custom_components.HeroSection: Full-width, dark bg, video/image overlay. Text: Huge Oswald font.
custom_components.BrandGrid: Grayscale logos that colorize on hover.

home.hero_text: Forging the Future with 40+ Years of Refractory Excellence.

products.features: Search bar, Brand filter, Grade filter (AL70, AL80).
products.card_style: Image top, Title bold, Specs list (Temp, Density) below.

brands.layout: Grid of cards. Each card features Brand Logo + Description + Key Products.

contact.features: WhatsApp floating button (Green), Quote Request Form (Detailed), Map.

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Oswald'.
Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure mobile responsiveness (stack grids to 1 col).
Add 'noise' texture to dark backgrounds for industrial feel.
